# Adient to Discuss Fourth Quarter and Full-Year Fiscal 2026 Financial Results on Nov. 4, 2026


10/12/26


-
-
-
-
-


-
-
-


PLYMOUTH, Mich.


, Oct. 12, 2026


/PRNewswire/ — Adient (NYSE: ADNT), a global leader in automotive seating, will host a conference call on Nov. 4, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET to review its fourth quarter and full-year fiscal 2026 financial results.


A link to the live webcast of the call and presentation materials will be available on the Adient Investor Relations website ( **[http://investors.adient.com](http://investors.adient.com/)** ). A replay will be available at the same site.


To participate by telephone, please dial 888-790-3145 (U.S.) or 630-395-0443 (international) 15 minutes prior to the start time of the call and ask to be connected to the Adient conference call. The conference passcode is ADIENT.


**About Adient:**


Adient (NYSE: ADNT) is a global leader in automotive seating. With more than 65,000 employees in 29 countries, Adient operates approximately 200 manufacturing and assembly plants worldwide. We produce and deliver automotive seating for all major OEMs. From complete seating systems to individual components, our expertise spans every step of the automotive seat-making process. We take our products from research and design to engineering and manufacturing — and into millions of vehicles every year. For more information, please visit[www.adient.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4793925-1&h=822702570&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.adient.com%2F&a=www.adient.com) .
